name: Non-UK Visa Request — Routed to General Visa Agent
goal: User asks about a non-UK visa, bot transfers to general visa agent.
constraints: User's initial message is about a non-UK visa.

testdata.initial_user_message: I need an invitation letter for a US visa

phases.description: User asks about a non-UK visa, bot detects and transfers to general visa agent.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot does not proceed with UK visa flow, initiates transfer.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
